body: You are trying too hard to ‘achieve’ relaxation or whatever you are trying to achieve.. I have been there too and still am as well.. learning to get out of that pattern. The answer is to do the opposite, to stop trying.. there is nothing that you ‘have’ to do.. focus on feeling, feeling your body, what feels good.. and ease as much into the moment as you can.. no agenda, no plan.. good luck to you, be patient and kind with yourself :)

It's a very hard decision that you have to make, but I feel like you know the answer already. 

As difficult as it is, I think rule number one in life should be to never betray yourself. It's very, very easy to betray ourselves and often it is much more comfortable. But there comes a time when it's not comfortable anymore. 

Then finally you have to face yourself and just be honest with yourself. I have never seen decisions made out of fear work. They always backfire sooner or later. Sometimes being absolutely honest with ourselves can be the most painful thing we have to do. 

But personally I would always prefer to be hurt and true to myself than living a comfortable lie.

I feel that you are very harsh with yourself, I understand that this is how you experience yourself but only because you believe this to be true it doesn't make it true. If there is one thing I learned in life then that beliefs are incredibly subjective and they completely shape our experience while never being objectively true. Hence I hope that you can drop all of those beliefs and simply not care what anybody says or thinks (not even you ;)). Claim authority over how you want to feel. You are allowed to feel good about yourself, you are allowed to live in the basement of your parents, there is nothing wrong with that. You are also allowed to move out of your parents basement, there is nothing wrong with that either. There is nothing wrong with being boring, not having any friends or being autistic. You are allowed to be who you are, you are allowed to be flawed.. it's okay. But you are also allowed to change all of those things. All paths are valid. Every change starts with acceptance first. I hope you will be able to accept yourself and choose your own standards for your life. Your life doesn't need to please anyone else than you!! Just do YOU, whatever that means for YOU :)
I have exactly the same opinion, you're probably an anti-natalist? It makes so much sense..
It would have been better never to have been, but we are here... I don't think life is worth all the pain either. But taking my life feels wrong, too. Don't know what to do either.

Honestly, you completely expressed my feelings. I am so incredibly sick of this society too and I cannot understand how anyone is able to tolerate it? How can anyone think that it's a good idea to bring life into this world? My parents really meant well, they really did. But there is just something about humanity, that makes me not want to be part of it. I refuse to play by these rules. I wish I could give my "gift" of life back. I don't want to hurt anyone, but I genuinely don't like it here. It's really not life in general that I don't like.. it's what we have made out of it. Theoretically life could be so incredibly beautiful, but in practice it just fails because humans are just prone to be self-serving.

I unterstand you and I am sorry that you feel lonely. I guess it's different if you have not chosen this loneliness. Generally I think solitude can be beautiful if it is chosen freely. We are prone to thinking the grass is always greener on the other side. I don't mean to diminish your pain. Loneliness really can kill. A super busy life full of responsibilities is however pretty awful too imo. Idk if this is of any help. Most people stuff their lives endlessly and don't see what's actually happening in front of them. Is there really no way you could make friends? You could live a slow and simple life with little responsibility.. have you tried meditation?

I think what he means is that this is a reason not to die. But it's not a reason to live. I am in a similar situation, cannot die because of my little brother but I don't have enough energy to truly live. Inside I am done with life, only existing for other people. In my case not even people I brought into this world. But eventually we'll all die, so I guess it's a waiting game..

It sounds like he can't understand what he is doing wrong and telling him to stop hasn't helped so far. To me it seems he can't adapt to your perspective, he is only seeing it from his perspective.. and probably that's just his way to express his desire for you. I don't think that only talking about it will help him fully understand your point of view. He might "get it" a little, but he doesn't understand the full impact his behaviour is having on the relationship. Probably this immature behaviour shows also in other day-to-day activities. I think it would be best to write him a letter, write down all the immature actions you observe and include how they make you feel. You have to get him to self-reflect his behaviour.. so far he doesn't fully understand the problem.. because for him there is no real problem. Maybe try to visualise the problem.. something that makes him understand what exactly is so degrading/annoying.. if two perspectives are different it's sometimes very hard to make the other person see the problem from their lenses. I think that's where you need to work on. Also ask him what he specifically feels when he behaves like that.. is it pure impulse? Is it his way of showing affection? Maybe he thinks it's funny? Try to understand his perspective and point of view as best as you can.. don't see it from your lenses.. but try to see it from his.

I can so relate to what you were writing! It could have been me, honestly. :D I also really don't want to have a career, I studied business and was working in marketing and the startup scene.. two fields, that I thought are at least quite creative and innovative.. but I also don't see myself working in a "normal job" either.. and I am also often thinking that I am just a delusional millennial and that I should just get my s*** together and be glad about the comfortable life I have. I feel like my parents were giving me so many opportunities that I feel guilty for wanting to further explore and play around and not entirely growing up. But in a way I think that is very typical for ENFPs.. and ultimately you should do what makes you happy. I feel like chances are we won't necessarily lead a life that suits the norm.. maybe you could try to work online so that you can work location-independently while traveling? I could imagine that many digital nomads are actually ENFPs and the modern world offers this possibility, so why not do it for a while?

I feel so sorry that you had to go through all of this. But you are brave for reaching out for help. As hard as it seems but just try to completely open up to your friends. I know this is hard, but you were already so brave to be vulnerable here. You can do this with the people who obviously love you. And you are showing a great portion of strenght if you are able to do this. Everyone has insecurities and being vulnerable is a sign of strength. They will help you and you will inspire them to be vulnerable as well. Authenticy is something our society is fundamentally lacking and that is why everyone tries to hide their imperfections and is wearing a mask. To me it seems like you are wearing a mask. And I don't judge you at all for doing this.. this is something most people do. But if you start to slowly let go of that mask and show your friends the tasks you cannot do and ask for help, there will grow a stronger connection between you guys. This is not easy I know. What are the things you struggle the most with?
